nodes.name: Episodic Memory (Phase 1 — contract + repository)

source_of_truth.scope: Phase 1 durable episodic-event contract and append-only Postgres repository only
source_of_truth.precedence: not wired into the live turn loop, context builder, or retrieval; docs/research/BOSS_MEMORY_RETRIEVAL_ARCHITECTURE_2026-08.md is the design authority this implements

notes: Design authority: docs/research/BOSS_MEMORY_RETRIEVAL_ARCHITECTURE_2026-08.md (merged to main after this branch was cut; not added to canonical_docs here to avoid depending on a path absent from this branch's own diff).
Phase 1 scope only: EpisodicEntry contract + append-only PostgreSQL repository + migration + tests.
No live turn-loop wiring, no retrieval, no context.py changes, no ActionGateway coupling, no Money Printer logic, no Airtable changes.
insert() is the only write path; append-only by construction — corrections are new rows (event_type='correction'), never overwrites.
core/migrations/003_episodic_entries.sql had not been executed against production Postgres as of this node's valid_from date — verify current state before treating the table as live.
